selected.rationale: Loss on webapp->ordering-api hits a source-verified no-timeout caller, so order placement/history requests hang unbounded, exposing missing timeout and retry defenses on the core checkout path.
Loss on webapp->catalog-api hits a source-verified no-timeout/no-retry client, making catalog browsing and product pages hang, confirming availability loss on a primary user-facing edge.
Delay on webapp->ordering-api propagates 1:1 through the no-timeout OrderingService client, stalling checkout and order operations and exposing unbounded latency propagation.
Delay on webapp->catalog-api propagates unbounded through the no-timeout CatalogService client, blocking product browsing; no circuit breaker or per-request timeout exists.
Loss on webapp->basket-api leaves the cart/checkout calls without an explicit deadline, causing the WebApp to hang; this is a core cart dependency and likely lacks a timeout.
Loss on mobile-bff->ordering-api is a synchronous mobile order flow with no static timeout/retry evidence; unreachable ordering-api hangs the mobile BFF request and exposes missing timeout defense.
Delay on webapp->basket-api is propagated synchronously to the cart UI/checkout with no bounded timeout; a slow Basket.API stalls the entire cart operation.
Delay on mobile-bff->ordering-api creates unbounded latency in mobile order placement if the BFF lacks a deadline, revealing missing timeout/fallback on the ordering path.
